Reducer.run_allreduce_hook invokes _AllReduceBySumCommHook, which performs SUM without post-division.
Project bounded gradient averager packs then SUMs and divides byworld_size after the collective.
DDP also changes bucket membership and communication ordering relative to bounded reducer.
supporting_scope: PyTorch numerical accuracy documentation explicitly says floating-point addition/multiplication are not associative and mathematically identical computations need not be bitwise identical. This supports investigating arithmetic and collective path differences.
contrary_or_limitations: World16 is a power of two: pre-vs-post scaling alone is not sufficient evidence for observed drift; normal FP32 scaling may be exact.
No HCCL collective trace or controlled bucket/order/scaling A/B has isolated a root cause.
